bagPolicy.summary: At UCLA athletics events, clear bags up to 12" x 12" x 6" and bags or clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5" are allowed. UCLA encourages fans not to bring any bags.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12" x 12" x 6"
Bags, purses or clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5"
Medical and diaper bags, subject to search
prohibited: Backpacks, bags or purses larger than 4.5" x 6.5"
Clear bags larger than 12" x 12" x 6"
bagPolicy.note: UCLA's gameday page lists a complimentary bag check for non-compliant bags. Outside food is allowed only inside a clear bag. This policy is published by UCLA Athletics.

parking.summary: UCLA identifies Lots 4 and 8 as the most convenient parking for Pauley Pavilion and advises patrons to buy parking in advance through the UCLA ePermit system.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Pauley Pavilion. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: UCLA says concessions are available around the Pauley Pavilion concourse. Beer, wine, and seltzers are specifically listed for men's and women's basketball events, while the reviewed page does not publish a concert-specific concessions list.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating is available, and standard tickets may be exchanged for accessible seats at Customer Service or the Box Office when inventory permits. Assistive listening devices are available at the Game Management Office in Room 271.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The reviewed official Pauley Pavilion venue guidance does not state a specific re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The Pauley Pavilion box office opens 30 minutes before doors open for all events.

gates.summary: For UCLA athletics, doors open 60 minutes before game time, or 90 minutes before premier men's and women's basketball games, and some events open earlier with notice to ticket holders. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
